Next year’s fall iPhone lineup is expected to include 20th anniversary redesigned Pro models and an iPhone Duo 2. Here’s what to expect per the latest leaks.

Here’s what to expect from iPhone 20 Pro and iPhone Duo 2, per latest leaks

Rumors for next year’s flagship new iPhone models are ramping up. Earlier today, we got a release timing update on iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 and learned that Apple may have multiple iPhone 20 Pro designs in testing.

Now more details have arrived via Weibo leakers Digital Chat Station and Fixed Focus Digital, who focus on the highly-anticipated new iPhone Pro models and also the iPhone Duo 2.

Fixed Focus Digital says the ‘iPhone 20 Pro’ will indeed return to a curved design, similar to the iPhone Air with more rounded edges. This echoes what the leaker shared earlier this week, but there’s one new tidbit: he says early prototypes include a titanium frame.

Apple used titanium for the iPhone 15 Pro and 16 Pro, then abandoned it with the 17 Pro and 18 Pro. Titanium is used on the iPhone Air though. With next year’s 20th anniversary Pro models taking design cues from the Air, it sounds like titanium could return.

Top comment by GTA

If faceID isn't coming to the Duo2 and there is no change to the screen size, then they should just keep selling the Duo1 next year and then come out with the Duo2 two years from now with faceID and a telephoto camera as tech gets smaller/better.

Leaker Digital Chat Station, in a reply to this post about iPhone Duo 2, adds that the 20 Pro series will be larger in size and have a bezel-free, quad-curved display.

Regarding the Duo 2, he says it will have the same 7.6-inch inner display and 5.4-inch outer display as the first model. The side button with integrated Touch ID remains unchanged as well.

On the possibility of Face ID being added, he says it’s “questionable.” He suggests internal components might require too many changes, but doesn’t offer inside information.

Which new model are you more interested in: the iPhone 20 Pro or iPhone Duo 2? Let us know in the comments.
